relations.name: OpenAI
relations.quote: We have a long-term strategic partnership with OpenAI which was originally established in 2019.

relations.name: OpenAI
relations.quote: For fiscal year 2026, we recorded revenue from commercial arrangements with OpenAI, inclusive of revenue-sharing payments, of $ 24.1 billion, and accounts receivable from OpenAI as of June 30, 2026 was $ 6.0 billion.

relations.name: OpenAI
relations.quote: We hold rights to OpenAI's intellectual property, including models and infrastructure, for integration into our products.
